validationProtocol.bootstrap: 90% cluster interval over time blocks x sets
validationProtocol.setHoldout: leave-one-set-out within each rolling score block

samplingRule: deterministic N-of-M variant sample: every (productId, subTypeName) key is ranked by sha256(f'{productId}|{subTypeName}')'s hex digest (ties broken by the key itself), and the first N in that ranking are kept -- order-independent (depends only on the key set, not on load order) and exactly reproducible.
